title: Carney Says Canada Will Reach Trade Deal With US
description:
Prime Minister Mark Carney says Canada will come to an agreement on trade with the US at some point. He says Canada is ready to sit down and negotiate. Talks broke down on August 21. Carney speaks exclusively to Bloomberg's Brian Platt in Toronto ahead of a major global investors summit.
